short_description: Straightforward clearinghouse with unlimited claims at $120/month flat rate and transparent pricing.
long_description: Claim.MD is a healthcare clearinghouse that differentiates itself through transparent, flat-rate pricing at $120/month for unlimited claims. Founded in 2002 and based in Lubbock, Texas, Claim.MD connects to over 4,000 payers and processes professional (837P), institutional (837I), and dental (837D) claims. The platform is popular among small to mid-size practices, including mental health providers, who appreciate the predictable monthly cost without per-claim fees. Claim.MD offers real-time eligibility verification, electronic remittance advice (ERA), and claim status tracking. While it lacks the AI-powered features of enterprise platforms like Waystar, Claim.MD provides reliable, cost-effective claims processing that meets the needs of most therapy practices.

faqs.a: Claim.MD charges a flat $120/month for unlimited claims with no per-claim fees. There's no setup fee and they offer a 30-day free trial. Additional locations are $60/month each. This transparent pricing makes budgeting predictable for small to mid-size practices.

faqs.q: Does Claim.MD work with my mental health EHR?
faqs.a: Claim.MD integrates with most practice management systems and EHRs through standard ANSI X12 EDI connections. Mental health EHRs like SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, and others can typically send claims through Claim.MD. Check with your EHR vendor for specific integration instructions.

faqs.q: How many payers does Claim.MD connect to?
faqs.a: Claim.MD connects to over 4,000 payers including all major commercial insurers, Medicare, and Medicaid programs. They handle professional (837P), institutional (837I), and dental (837D) claim types.

faqs.q: Is Claim.MD good for therapy practices?
faqs.a: Claim.MD is excellent for therapy practices billing 50+ claims per month because the flat $120/month rate becomes very cost-effective compared to per-claim pricing. It's straightforward without complex features, which suits practices wanting reliable claims processing without enterprise complexity.
